To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the mechanisms of calculatives, affective and belief have a significant impact on firm performance.
trust mechanisms are positively associated with performance.

(1) calculative, affectiveness and belief mechanisms have direct impact on firm performance; (2) the impact of the mechanism embeddedness on performance is mediated by calculative mechanism; (3) the impact of continuity mechanism on performance is mediated both by calculative and belief mechanisms; (4) the impact of capability mechanism on performance is not mediated by any of the other mechanisms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of trust mechanisms on performance and contributes to the literature by providing a framework of trust mechanisms in channel relationships.
the mechanisms of trust and their impact on performance.
the development of trust in business relationships and the impact on performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
trust is a complex phenomenon, but it is possible to develop it in a way that it contributes to firm performance.
the trust relationship is a combination of calculative, belief and affective mechanisms.
trust is a multidimensional construct that is built on a combination of mechanisms, which can be used to achieve better performance in channel relationships.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
managers need to be aware of the mechanisms that can be used to build and maintain trust in channel relationships and that the mechanisms can be used in a complementary way to achieve performance.
trust is an important issue in business and managers must develop trust relationships using a combination of mechanisms.
trust is a multidimensional concept and managers should be able to understand and use the mechanisms to develop trust in their relationships.
The main takeaway from our work is that
managers should not only focus on one mechanism, but should consider a combination of them.
managers can develop trust in their channel relationships by using the mechanisms of calculatives, affectives and belief.
managers need to develop trust relationships and to do that they need to use a combination of mechanisms.
